Daemon running

WooAgent OS daemon is up — but the UI isn't bundled in this binary.

This is the placeholder served when the daemon was built without the UI assets copied into the embed directory. Two ways to get the real UI:

Install a release

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automattic/wooagent-os/trunk/install.sh | bash

Release binaries always include the UI baked in.

Build from source

cd ui && npm install && npm run build
bash scripts/build-ui-into-daemon.sh
cd daemon && go build ./cmd/wooagent

Or for fast iteration, run the Vite dev server in a separate terminal — the daemon's CORS allows cross-origin connections from http://localhost:5173:

cd ui && npm run dev
